wemath.notes: per problem group (ID): CM = all steps and the multi-step question correct, IG = all steps correct but multi wrong, RM = some step wrong but multi correct, IK = some step wrong and multi wrong; pinned Score (Strict) = (525 - 0.5 IG - RM - IK) / 525 formatted '{:.2%}' (two decimals)

row_diagnostics.basis: archived 0/1 question scores; the official unit is the problem group

wemath.subset_semantics: (G - 0.5 IG - RM - IK) / G x 100 over the G complete problem groups present, unrounded unless G = 525 (full split: the pinned value with its two-decimal rounding). Departs from the pinned scorer on subsets, whose fixed denominator 525 scores every absent group as mastered; needs a DESIGN.md amendment. A subset run's own score campaign reports the fixed-525 value (campaign_value / pinned_fixed525_score), which is what its cross-check compares
